title: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
abstract: arXiv:2608.01460v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification that has recently been adapted to large language models (LLMs), providing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability. Yet for LLMs, nonconformity scores are often induced by an inference pipeline, not just a fixed model, making them depend not only on the data distribution but also on configurable factors such as the prompt template, decoding parameters, and deployment setting. Since such configurations are routinely modified in practice but rarely treated as a source of shift, their impact on CP validity remains poorly understood. We call this \emph{configuration shift} and study it systematically along three axes: prompt template, decoding temperature, and weight quantization. translated_title: 配置偏移下的共形化大语言模型
translated_abstract: 共形预测是一种无分布假设的不确定性量化框架，最近已被应用于大语言模型，能够在可交换性条件下提供具有有限样本覆盖保证的预测集合。然而，对于大语言模型而言，非一致性分数往往由推理流程诱导产生，而不仅仅取决于一个固定的模型，这使得其不仅依赖于数据分布，还依赖于诸如提示模板、解码参数和部署设置等可配置因素。由于这类配置在实践中经常被修改，却很少被视为偏移的来源，其对共形预测有效性的影响至今仍鲜为人知。我们将这种现象称为“配置偏移”，并从三个维度对其进行系统研究：提示模板、解码温度和权重量化。在一项涵盖9个大语言模型、4个数据集和4种非一致性分数的广泛实证研究中，我们发现配置偏移持续地
tldr: 该论文首次提出“配置偏移”这一概念，系统揭示了大语言模型推理配置（提示模板、解码温度、权重量化）的改变会破坏共形预测覆盖保证的有效性，并通过涵盖9个模型、4个数据集和4种非一致性分数的大规模实证研究加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel concept of "configuration shift," systematically revealing that changes in LLM inference configurations—prompt templates, decoding temperature, and weight quantization—can invalidate the coverage guarantees of conformal prediction, validated through a large-scale empirical study spanning 9 LLMs, 4 datasets, and 4 nonconformity scores.
